parameters.content:
## InvestorUpdateEngine
Drafts the monthly investor update from a Google Sheet.

All maths lives in the sheet as formulas. AI only writes text. Nothing is sent: the result is a Gmail draft.

Setup: see README.

### 1 · Read the numbers
Monthly tab incl. formula columns (burn, runway, growth, churn, data checks, warnings, status). LatestMonth keeps the newest row.

### 2 · AI writes text only
Founder notes from the Highlights tab. Rule: no digits, no invented facts. Model: free OpenRouter model.

### 3 · Check, draft, alert
CheckText: status must be OK or WARNING, AI text must contain no digits. Otherwise the subject is flagged. Draft goes to Gmail, alert to Telegram.
